retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant, flat-perspective collage combining musical instruments with tropical beach life using hand-drawn textures and bold color blocking.
triggerTerms: hand-lettered script on textured red borders
excludeWhen: modern digital vector minimalism is requested
dark or moody atmospheric lighting is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition featuring a central acoustic guitar flanked by stylized figures on a beach. The style uses flat planes of color, visible paper edges, and hand-painted textures like wood grain and sand patterns, framed by deep red horizontal bands containing fluid script.
coreVisualRelationships: Acoustic guitar as the vertical anchor dividing the scene
Figures in motion framed by geometric beach architecture
Textured background elements like mountains and sea in the upper third
Bold horizontal framing bands at top and bottom
coreInvariants: Visible brushstrokes and tactile paper textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large acoustic guitar centered vertically; human figures scaled smaller to the left and right sides.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical neck and body of the guitar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top script, down the guitar neck, then outward to the walking figure on the right and the seated figure on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with overlapping shapes and patterns.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and sandy yellow (beach and guitar)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep terracotta red (top and bottom borders)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Sky blue and lime green (water and citrus details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with mid-range values; shadows are represented by darker color blocks rather than gradients.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width mimicking a brush or felt-tip pen
Connected lowercase letters with exaggerated horizontal flourishes
Large, expressive capital letters with high-reaching ascenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital R and S feature long, sweeping horizontal tails
Lowercase 'i' dots are integrated into the fluid motion of the line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script used for both title and artist name to maintain a cohesive hand-crafted feel.

preserve: Contrast between yellow text and red background

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the relaxed, artistic vibe of the original lettering

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a flat, mixed-media collage of a beach scene. Center a large acoustic guitar vertically. On the left, a seated person near a wooden hut with citrus slices. On the right, a person in swimwear walking. Use gouache textures, paper cutout edges, and a palette of ochre, red, and blue. Include thick solid red horizontal bands at the very top and bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-lettered, fluid cursive script in golden yellow onto the top and bottom red bands. The lettering should look like it was painted with a brush, featuring long horizontal flourishes.

verificationChecks: Is the guitar the central vertical axis?
Are the top and bottom borders solid red?
Does the text have a hand-painted, cursive quality?
Is the overall style flat and textured rather than 3D?

adjustableVariables: Width of the top and bottom framing bands
mustRedesign: Any specific faces or recognizable people
Specific brand logos on the guitar
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the red background
Verify the collage elements feel layered rather than merged
Check that the guitar strings are represented as thin, hand-drawn lines
Confirm the presence of the horizontal framing bands
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [central object] with [lifestyle scene] in a [mid-century collage style] using [gouache textures] and [hand-lettered script] on [colored horizontal borders].
